## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what was broken and what now happens. Link relevant issues without claiming unfinished acceptance criteria.

## Validation

Record exact commands, outcomes, and evidence. Distinguish mocks, real Testnet transactions, and external blockers.

## Security and persistence

Describe signing/auth changes, database migrations, compatibility impact, and residual risks. Never include seeds or provider credentials.

## Remaining limitations

List unfinished work and deployment needs. Contract deployment and production updates require explicit maintainer approval.
